name: nvidia/simready-assets
description:
Welcome to NVIDIA SimReady Assets
	

Welcome to NVIDIA's open-source SimReady Assets dataset!
SimReady Central brings together OEM-curated datasets like this one, helping you discover simulation-ready assets for your projects.
Interested in contributing? Visit nvidia/simready-central-library and request contributor access through the Community tab.
